title: Homogeneity, Isotropy, and Determinism Force a Quadratic Spacetime Interval: A Derivation of Relativity Without Light
summary: We show that a few physical principles -- smoothness, homogeneity, isotropy, and the determinism of inertial motion -- force the invariant interval governing the geometry of spacetime to reduce to a quadratic form, without presupposing the existence of light or electromagnetic phenomena.
